```{r}
clean_data <- read.csv("../cleaning/new/final_clean_data.csv",stringsAsFactors = FALSE,na.strings = c("", "NA"),check.names = FALSE)
# Export unique parameter names for manual review
parameter_name <- unique(clean_data$parameter_name)
write.csv(parameter_name, "parameter_name.csv")
```
## Parameter table
```{r}
library(dplyr)

parameter_table <- clean_data %>%
  transmute(
    parameter_stable_id = trimws(as.character(parameter_stable_id)),
    parameter_name = trimws(as.character(parameter_name))
  ) %>%
  filter(
# Exclude records without a parameter ID from the parameter table
    !is.na(parameter_stable_id),
    parameter_stable_id != ""
  ) %>%
  distinct() %>%
# Arrange rows to make the table easier to inspect
  arrange(parameter_stable_id)

# A result of 0 means there are no duplicated parameter IDs.
sum(duplicated(parameter_table$parameter_stable_id))
```
## Group table
```{r}
group_table <- data.frame(
  group_id = 1:16,
  group_name = c("Weight","Images","Brain","Blood lipids","Glucose tolerance","Bone size/mineralisation","Freezing behaviour","Prepulse inhibition","ABR auditory threshold","Sleep","Adrenal gland","Haematology","Body composition","Liver clinical chemistry","Renal clinical chemistry","Cardiovascular"),
  description = c(
    "Body weight and body mass measurements, organ weights, and other measurements expressed relative to or normalised against body weight.",
    "Image-derived or visually assessed morphology and structure candidates.",
    "Brain and brain-region parameters, including cerebellum, cerebral cortex, hippocampus and hypothalamus.",
    "Cholesterol, triglyceride, lipoprotein and fatty-acid measurements.",
    "Glucose challenge, glucose response, insulin and HbA1c measurements.",
    "Bone area, mineral content, mineral density and length.",
    "Freezing and fear-conditioning measurements.",
    "Prepulse inhibition measurements.",
    "Auditory brainstem response threshold measurements.",
    "Sleep duration, bout and sleep-associated measurements.",
    "Adrenal gland measurements and terms.",
    "Blood cell counts, differential counts, red-cell indices and immune-cell subsets, including T, B, NK and NKT cells.",
    "Fat and lean mass and body-composition ratios.",
    "Liver-associated clinical chemistry measurements.",
    "Renal-associated clinical chemistry measurements.",
    "Heart and cardiovascular structure or function measurements."
  ),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
```
## Search groups
```{r}
parameter_name <- parameter_table$parameter_name

group_list <- list(
  "Weight" = grepl("weight|body mass",parameter_name,ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Images" = grepl(
  "morphology|retina|retinal|lens density|blood vessels?.*(pattern|structure)|(pattern|structure).*blood vessels?|corneal thickness|vitreous.*thickness|coat.*colour pattern|coat.*color pattern|bone area|bone mineral (content|density)|fat mass|lean mass",
  parameter_name,
  ignore.case = TRUE
) &!grepl("^(left|right) retina$",parameter_name,ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Brain" = grepl("brain|brainstem|forebrain|hindbrain|midbrain|cerebellum|cerebral cortex|hippocampus|hypothalamus",parameter_name,ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Blood lipids" =grepl("cholesterol|triglyceride|free fatty acid|lipoprotein|apolipoprotein",parameter_name, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Glucose tolerance" =grepl("glucose|insulin|glycos[iy]lated hemoglobin A1c",parameter_name, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Bone size/mineralisation" =grepl("bone area|bone mineral (content|density)|BMC/BMD|BMC/body weight|tibia length",parameter_name, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Freezing behaviour" =grepl("freezing", parameter_name, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Prepulse inhibition" =grepl("pre.?pulse inhibition", parameter_name, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "ABR auditory threshold" =grepl("ABR.*threshold", parameter_name, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Sleep" =grepl("sleep", parameter_name, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Adrenal gland" =grepl("adrenal gland", parameter_name, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Haematology" = grepl(
  "red blood cell|white blood cell|platelet|hemoglobin|haemoglobin|hematocrit|haematocrit|mean[- ](cell|corpuscular)|eosinophil|basophil|neutrophil|monocyte|lymphocyte|reticulocyte|T cells?|B cells?|NK cells?|NKT cells?|B1B|B2B|B1a|CD[0-9]+",
  parameter_name,
  ignore.case = TRUE
),

  "Body composition" =grepl("fat mass|lean mass|fat/body weight|lean/body weight|BMC/body weight|body composition|adiposity",parameter_name, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Liver clinical chemistry" =grepl("alanine aminotransferase|aspartate aminotransferase|alkaline phosphatase|bilirubin|gamma.?glutamyl",parameter_name, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Renal clinical chemistry" =grepl("creatinine|urea|uric acid|microalbumin|BUN",parameter_name, ignore.case = TRUE),
  "Cardiovascular" =grepl("heart|cardiac|QRS|ECG|stroke volume",parameter_name, ignore.case = TRUE)
)

# Check that group names match the names used in the grouping rules
setequal(group_table$group_name, names(group_list))

```
## Parameter-group member table
```{r}
# member_id gives each group-parameter relationship a unique identifier,
# making it easier to define a single-column primary key in SQL.
parameter_group_member <- data.frame(
  member_id = integer(),
  group_id = integer(),
  parameter_stable_id = character(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Add one row for each group-parameter match; a parameter may belong to multiple groups.
for (g in names(group_list)) {
  selected <- parameter_table[group_list[[g]], , drop = FALSE]

  if (nrow(selected) > 0) {
    group_id <- group_table$group_id[
      match(g, group_table$group_name)
    ]

    new_rows <- data.frame(
  member_id = nrow(parameter_group_member) + seq_len(nrow(selected)),
  group_id = rep(group_id, nrow(selected)),
  parameter_stable_id = selected$parameter_stable_id,
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

    parameter_group_member <- rbind(parameter_group_member,new_rows)
  }
}

parameter_group_member <- unique(parameter_group_member)
```

## Export
```{r}
# Export the three tables for database import.
write.csv(parameter_table, "parameter_table.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(group_table, "parameter_group.csv", row.names = FALSE)
write.csv(parameter_group_member, "parameter_group_member.csv", row.names = FALSE)
```

## Review of group assignments
```{r}
# Join the tables for manual review of group assignments
group_review <- merge(parameter_group_member,group_table,by = "group_id")
group_review <- merge(group_review,parameter_table,by = "parameter_stable_id")
group_review <- group_review[
  order(group_review$group_id, group_review$parameter_name),
]

#View(group_review)
```
